issues.title: Ingest Drew County’s 2026 budget
issues.detail: The county’s 2026 budget as filed with the state (artransparency.gov, May 2026), turned into a money trail with a page cite on every amount.

stamped.revealed: $14,912,137 across 21 funds. The largest: General Fund ($6,018,906), One Cent Special Road Sales Tax Fund ($2,763,000), Road Fund ($2,648,239). Every total marked complete adds to its parts to the cent; where the county’s own pages disagree, the page keeps the printed number and an open question below.

issues.title: Reconcile General Fund
issues.detail: Printed total is $6,018,906.20; the departments listed add to $6,018,896.20. Ask the county treasurer or clerk which figure is right, and how the adopted amount splits.

issues.title: Reconcile 10th Judicial Dist. Circuit Division (General Fund)
issues.detail: Printed total is $84,126.01; the categories listed add to $84,626.01. Categories from the department budget page (p. 48). Ask the county treasurer or clerk which figure is right, and how the adopted amount splits.
